roles_note: Query Report and Script Report also need Script Manager (KIND.roles_for(spec)); disable needs System Manager only
description: Request approval to create, change or disable a custom report (Report Builder first; Query Report for a join or aggregate; Script Report for multi-select filters, permission-respecting reads and computed columns)

builder.description: Report Builder: {fields:[[fieldname, doctype]], filters:[[doctype, fieldname, operator, value]], order_by:'`tabX`.`f` desc', group_by:{group_by:'`tabX`.`f`', aggregate_function:'count|sum|avg', aggregate_on:'f'}, add_totals_row:0|1}

query.description: Query Report: one SELECT; filters as %(fieldname)s

report_script.description: Script Report: Python run as the viewer with the local `filters`; set data = [columns, rows] (or result = rows with columns). Read with frappe.get_list. Server Script language rules: no import, no return

javascript.description: Script Report filters: frappe.query_reports["<report_name>"] = {filters: [{fieldname, label, fieldtype (Link, MultiSelectList, Date, Select...), options, default, reqd, get_data, get_query}]}. Do not send `filters` with it

filters.description: Query Report filters, or Script Report filters when there is no javascript

roles.description: Who may run it; default: roles that can read ref_doctype

sample_filters.description: Values for the preview run (a MultiSelectList value is a list)
